minor.issue: 'values that separate accolade groups at each position' overstates descriptive means that were never tested; at some positions (e.g., running back vertical jump 87.73/87.48/87.35) the groups barely differ.
'Combine measures differ ... by Pro Bowl or All-Pro status' should say the differences are descriptive only, because no significance testing was done.

'excluded undrafted attendees and nonattendees' is not quite what the source says. The source notes that some combine participants were never drafted and some drafted players did not attend, so only part of their data is available. The counts (4,914 combine participants vs 3,844 drafted) suggest undrafted attendees were included.
It does not state that only descriptive means were reported with no inferential tests, and it misses the conflict between the abstract and the table on running back body mass.
The advice on tissue capacity and on avoiding unsafe mass change is generic and not drawn from the source.
It gives no numbers from Table 3.

note: A's example values (QB 40-yard 4.83/4.80/4.77, All-Pro QBs taller and heavier) match Table 3, and A correctly flags the absence of inferential testing and the abstract-versus-table conflict on running back mass, which B misses.
